input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 binds only Customer with a no-hire ("hire, or employ") covering every Vendor employee for 24 months post-term, expressly reaching employees who apply on their own initiative ("regardless of how the employee applies"), so there is no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. That is at the playbook walk-away line (no-hire, all Vendor personnel, 24 months) and it also contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire any person responding to general recruitment. We therefore delete the clause to reach the preferred position, offering the narrow mutual 12-month non-solicit with carve-outs as fallback.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted Section 12.4: our position is that we do not accept non-solicitation or no-hire restrictions on Customer, and this clause is inconsistent with Section 12.3, under which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and remains free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment. If Vendor needs protection, we can accept a mutual non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire element.
proposal.summary: Delete the one-sided 24-month no-hire/non-solicit imposed on Customer in 12.4
